options.name: access_based_enumeration
options.description: Defines if access based enumeration for SMB is enabled

options.name: anongid
options.description: The ID to which any users whose GID is affected by I(access) of I(root-squash) or I(all-squash) will be mapped to. This is ignored when I(user_mapping) is enabled. Clear using "".

options.name: anonuid
options.description: The ID to which any users whose UID is affected by I(access) of I(root-squash) or I(all-squash) will be mapped to. Clear using "".

options.name: api_token
options.description: FlashArray API token for admin privileged user.

options.name: client
options.description: Specifies which SMB or NFS clients are given access Accepted notation, IP, IP mask, or hostname

options.name: client_id
options.description: ID of the API Client that issues the identity token. Used with I(private_key_file).

options.name: context
options.description: Name of fleet member on which to perform the operation. This requires the array receiving the request is a member of a fleet and the context name to be a member of the same fleet.

options.name: continuous_availability
options.description: Defines if continuous availability on the policy. When continuous availability is enabled on a policy, file shares are accessible during otherwise disruptive scenarios such as temporary network outages, controller upgrades or failovers.

options.name: directory
options.description: Directories to have the quota rule applied to.

options.name: disable_warnings
options.description: Disable insecure certificate warnings in debug logs

options.name: enabled
options.description: Define if policy is enabled or not

options.name: enforce_dictionary_check
options.description: If I(true), test password against dictionary of known leaked passwords. Only applies to passwords longer than 6 characters.

options.name: enforce_username_check
options.description: If I(true), the username cannot be a substring of the password. It only applies to usernames of 3 characters and longer

options.name: fa_url
options.description: FlashArray management IPv4 address or Hostname.

options.name: id_token
options.description: A pre-signed JWT to authenticate with, as an alternative to I(api_token). The token is exchanged by the array for a short-lived access token. Requires a matching API Client to be registered on the array (see M(everpure.flasharray.purefa_apiclient)).

options.name: ignore_usage
options.description: Flag used to override checks for quota management operations. If set to true, directory usage is not checked against the quota_limits that are set. If set to false, the actual logical bytes in use are prevented from exceeding the limits set on the directory. Client operations might be impacted. If the limit exceeds the quota, the client operation is not allowed.

options.name: issuer
options.description: The API Client's trusted identity issuer registered on the array. Used with I(private_key_file).

options.name: key_id
options.description: Key ID of the API Client that issues the identity token. Used with I(private_key_file).

options.name: lockout_duration
options.description: Account lockout duration, in seconds, after I(max_login_attempts) exceeded Range between 1 second and 90 days (7776000 seconds)

options.name: max_login_attempts
options.description: Maximum number of failed logins before account is locked

options.name: max_password_age
options.description: Maximum password age before a password must be changed. Value can be specified as a human-readable time period (e.g., C(90d), C(1w), C(24h)) or as an integer representing seconds. Supported time units are C(w) (weeks), C(d) (days), C(h) (hours), C(m) (minutes), C(s) (seconds). Range between 1 day and 99999 days. A value of 0 or C(0s) disables password expiration.

options.name: min_character_groups
options.description: The minimum number of character groups required to be present in a password.

options.name: min_characters_per_group
options.description: The minimum number of characters per group to count the group as present. Maximum is limited by the minimum password length divided by the number of character groups

options.name: min_password_age
options.description: Minimum password age before a password can be changed. Value can be specified as a human-readable time period (e.g., C(1d), C(2h), C(30m), C(60s)) or as an integer representing seconds. Supported time units are C(w) (weeks), C(d) (days), C(h) (hours), C(m) (minutes), C(s) (seconds). Range between 0 seconds (no minimum) and 7 days. A value of 0 or C(0s) means passwords can be changed immediately.

options.name: min_password_length
options.description: Minimum user password length

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the policy

options.name: nfs_access
options.description: Specifies access control for the export

options.name: nfs_permission
options.description: Specifies which read-write client access permissions are allowed for the export

options.name: nfs_version
options.description: NFS protocol version allowed for the export

options.name: password_history
options.description: The number of passwords tracked to prevent reuse of passwords. A value of 0 will not check password history

options.name: policy
options.description: The type of policy to use

options.name: private_key_file
options.description: Path to the PEM RSA private key used to sign an identity token, as an alternative to I(api_token). Requires I(client_id), I(key_id), I(issuer) and I(username).

options.name: private_key_password
options.description: Password protecting I(private_key_file), if encrypted.

options.name: quota_enforced
options.description: Defines if the directory quota is enforced.

options.name: quota_limit
options.description: Logical space limit of the share in M, G, T or P units. See examples. If size is not set at filesystem creation time the filesystem size becomes unlimited. This value cannot be set to 0.

options.name: quota_notifications
options.description: Targets to notify when usage approaches the quota limit. The list of notification targets is a comma-separated string If not specified, notification targets are not assigned.

options.name: rename
options.description: New name of policy

options.name: rule_name
options.description: Name of rule to update for a quota policy

options.name: security
options.description: The security flavors to use for accessing files on a mount point. If the server does not support the requested flavor, the mount operation fails. This operation updates all rules of the specified policy.

options.name: smb_anon_allowed
options.description: Specifies whether access to information is allowed for anonymous users

options.name: smb_encrypt
options.description: Specifies whether the remote client is required to use SMB encryption

options.name: snap_at
options.description: Specifies the number of hours since midnight at which to take a snapshot or the hour including AM/PM Can only be set on the rule with the smallest I(snap_every) value. Cannot be set if the I(snap_every) value is not measured in days. Can only be set for at most one rule in the same policy.

options.name: snap_client_name
options.description: The customizable portion of the client visible snapshot name.

options.name: snap_every
options.description: Specifies the interval between snapshots, in minutes. The value for all rules must be multiples of one another. Must be unique for each rule in the same policy. Value must be between 5 and 525600.

options.name: snap_keep_for
options.description: Specifies the period that snapshots are retained before they are eradicated, in minutes. Cannot be less than the I(snap_every) value of the rule. Value must be unique for each rule in the same policy. Value must be between 5 and 525600.

options.name: snap_suffix
options.description: The snapshot suffix name The suffix value can only be set for one rule in the same policy The suffix value can only be set on a rule with the same ``keep_for`` value and ``every`` value The suffix value can only be set on the rule with the largest ``keep_for`` value If not specified, defaults to a monotonically increasing number generated by the system.

options.name: state
options.description: Define whether the policy should exist or not.

options.name: user_mapping
options.description: Defines if user mapping is enabled

options.name: username
options.description: Username the issued token should be granted to. Must be a valid user on the array. Used with I(private_key_file).
